input_relations: elements of an eqType identified; its Lean DecidableEq instance is the eqType's decision procedure
sequences elementwise; options constructor-wise; natural numbers by SubNatRel; Boolean predicates T -> bool pointwise (two-way totals)
lean_representation_note: `find p s` is `List.findIdx p s`; `has p s` is `s.any p`; `uniq` is `Nodup`; `x != y` is `!decide (x = y)`
